Mech.name: Mech
Mech.description:
These stats are for a 12-foot-tall mechanized sentinel, as found in a hard scifi campaign. This is a light patrol-style platform with reasonable intelligence, a sensor package, and high maneuverability. Larger mechs outfitted for battle have substantially more armor, are larger, and have more specialized weaponry.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili05]{Construct}: +2 to recover from being @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken}; ignores 1 point of Wound penalties; does not breathe or suffer from @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04disease0000000]{disease} or @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04poison00000000]{poison}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili11]{Fearless}: Mechs are immune to @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04fear0000000000]{Fear} and @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Intimidation]{Intimidation}, but may be smart enough to react to fear-causing situations aptly.
  • Night Vision: Sensor packages ignore penalties for @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03illumination00]{Illumination}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 4 (Large): The mech stands 15′ tall.

Orc.name: Orc
Orc.description:
Orcs are savage, green-skinned humanoids with pig-like features, including snouts and sometimes even tusks. They have foul temperaments and rarely take prisoners.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili18]{Infravision}: Halve penalties for @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03illumination00]{Illumination} when attacking warm targets.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 1: Orcs are slightly larger than humans.

Summon Ally: Bodyguard.name: Summon Ally: Bodyguard
Summon Ally: Bodyguard.description:
Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili05]{Construct}: +2 to recover from being @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken}; ignore 1 point of Wound penalties; doesn't breathe, immune @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04disease0000000]{disease} or @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04poison00000000]{poison}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili11]{Fearless}: Immune to @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04fear0000000000]{fear} and @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Intimidation]{Intimidation}.

Zombie.name: Zombie
Zombie.description:
These walking dead are typical groaning fiends looking for fresh meat. 

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili11]{Fearless}: Immune to @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04fear0000000000]{fear} and @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Intimidation]{Intimidation}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili29]{Undead}: +2 Toughness; +2 to recover from being @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken}; no additional damage from @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0]{Called Shots}; ignores 1 point of Wound penalties; doesn’t breathe; immune to @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04disease0000000]{disease} and @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04poison00000000]{poison}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili31]{Weakness} (Head): @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03calledshots000]{Called Shots} to a zombie’s head do the usual +4 damage.

Dragon.name: Dragon
Dragon.description:
Dragons are fire-breathing monsters that bring doom and despair to the villages they ravage. Such creatures should not be fought lightly as they are more than a match for even a party of experienced adventurers. These beasts are quite intelligent as well, and use all of their advantages when confronted by would-be dragon-slayers.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili10]{Fear} (−2): Anyone who sees a mighty dragon must make a Fear check at −2.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili12]{Flight}: Dragons have a Flying Pace of 24″.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili14]{Hardy}: The creature does not suffer a Wound from being @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken} twice.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 8 (Huge): Dragons are massive crea­tures, over 40′ long from nose to tail and weighing over 30,000 pounds.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili27]{Swat}: Dragons ignore up to 4 points of @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03sizeandscale00]{Scale} penalties when attacking with their claws.

Ogre.name: Ogre
Ogre.description:
Ogres are kin to orcs and lesser giants. They are often taken in by orc clans, who respect the dumb brutes for their savagery and strength. Orcs often pit their “pet” ogres in savage combats against their rivals’.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili24]{Resilient}: Ogres can take one Wound before they’re @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Incapacitated}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 2: Most ogres are over 8′ tall with pot-bellies and massive arms and legs.

Giant Worm.name: Giant Worm
Giant Worm.description:
Massive worms tunneling beneath the earth to gobble up unsuspecting adventurers are sometimes found in lonesome flatlands. The things sense vibrations through the earth, hearing a walking person at about 200 yards. The stats below are for a monster some 50 feet long.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili03]{Burrow} (20″): Giant worms tunnel through the ground, blocked only by solid bedrock.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili14]{Hardy}: The creature does not suffer a Wound from being @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken} twice.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 9 (Huge): Giant worms are usually over 50′ long and 10′ or more in diameter.

Elemental, Earth.name: Elemental, Earth
Elemental, Earth.description:
Earth elementals manifest as five-foot-tall, vaguely man-shaped collections of earth and stone. Though strong, they are also quite slow and ponderous.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili03]{Burrow} (10″): Earth elementals can meld into and out of the ground.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili06]{Elemental}: No additional damage from @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0]{Called Shots}, ignores 1 point of Wound penalties, doesn’t breathe, immune to @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04disease0000000]{disease} and @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04poison00000000]{poison}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili16]{Immunity}: Immune to earth-based attacks (including thrown stones or powers with earth, mud, stone, or sand Trappings).
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili24]{Resilient}: Earth elementals can take one Wound before they’re Incapacitated.

Horse.name: Horse
Horse.description:
Riding horses compromise speed with carrying capacity.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 2: Typical quarter horse of about 1,000 lbs.

Ghost.name: Ghost
Ghost.description:
Specters, shades, and phantoms sometimes return from death to haunt the living or fulfill some unfinished business.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili09]{Ethereal}: Ghosts can become invisible and immaterial at will and can only be harmed by magical attacks.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili10]{Fear} (−2): Ghosts cause Fear checks at −2 when they let themselves be seen.

Mule.name: Mule
Mule.description:
Mules are a cross between a donkey and a horse, and are usually used to haul heavy goods or pull wagons.

Like any good pet, the GM should give the mule a little personality. The expression “stubborn as a mule” certainly comes to mind.

Special Abilities:

  • Ornery: Mules are contrary creatures. Characters must subtract 1 from their @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Riding]{Riding} rolls when riding them.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 2: Mules are stocky creatures usually weighing under 1000 pounds.

Summon Ally: Attendant.name: Summon Ally: Attendant
Summon Ally: Attendant.description:
Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili05]{Construct}: +2 to recover from being @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken}; ignore 1 point of Wound penalties; doesn't breathe, immune @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04disease0000000]{disease} or @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04poison00000000]{poison}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili11]{Fearless}: Immune to @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04fear0000000000]{fear} and @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Intimidation]{Intimidation}.

Dire Wolf.name: Dire Wolf
Dire Wolf.description:
Dire wolves are very large and feral canines often used by orcs as attack dogs. They may also be found roaming in packs in the deepest, darkest woods.

Special Abilities:

  • Speed: d10 @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{running die} .

Lion.name: Lion
Lion.description:
The kings of the jungle are fierce predators, particularly in open grassland where their prey cannot seek refuge.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili20]{Low Light Vision}: Lions ignore penalties for Dim and Dark @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03illumination00]{Illumination}.
  • Pounce: Lions pounce on their prey to best bring their mass and claws to bear. If a lion makes a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03wildattack0000]{Wild Attack}, it adds +4 to its damage instead of +2.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 1: Typical males are about 400 pounds.

Lich.name: Lich
Lich.description:
Perhaps the most diabolical creature in any fantasy land is the lich—a necromancer so consumed with the black arts that he eventually becomes undead himself.

Special Abilities:

  • Spells: Liches have 50 @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor05powers.JournalEntryPage.05arcanebackgr00]{Power Points} and know most every spell available.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili29]{Undead}: +2 Toughness; +2 to recover from being @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken}; no additional damage from @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0]{Called Shots}; ignores 1 point of Wound penalties; doesn’t breathe; immune to @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04disease0000000]{disease} and @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04poison00000000]{poison}.
  • Zombie: Liches are necromancers first and foremost. The undead they raise through the @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-powers.Zombie]{zombie} spell are permanent, and they may raise @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-bestiary.Skeleton]{skeletons} just like @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-bestiary.Zombie]{zombies} as they choose. Some liches have built up entire armies of the undead at their disposal.

Swarm.name: Swarm
Swarm.description:
Sometimes the most deadly foes come in the smallest packages. The swarm described here can be of most anything—from biting ants to stinging wasps to ﬁlthy rats. They cover an area equal to a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03areaeffectat00]{Large, Medium, or Small Blast Template} and attack everyone within it every round (unless @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken}). When a swarm is @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Incapacitated} it’s eﬀectively dispersed.

Swarms aren’t intelligent enough to do anything but move and bite and shouldn’t take @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03multiactions00]{Multi-Actions}, make @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03test0000000000]{Tests}, etc.

Special Abilities:

  • Split: Some swarms split into two smaller swarms when @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Wounded} (GM’s call). Reduce the @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03areaeffectat00]{Blast Template} one size after a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Wound}; Small swarms are destroyed.
  • Swarm: +2 to recover from being @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken}, @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01characters0000]{Parry} +2. Swarms are composed of many small creatures, so cutting and piercing weapons do no real damage. @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03areaeffectat00]{Area eﬀect attacks} work normally, and a character can stomp to inﬂict his damage in @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Strength} each round. Some swarms (bees, hornets, birds) may be foiled by total immersion in water.

Elemental, Fire.name: Elemental, Fire
Elemental, Fire.description:
Fire elementals appear as man-shaped flame.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili06]{Elemental}: No additional damage from @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0]{Called Shots}, ignores 1 point of Wound penalties, doesn’t breathe, immune to @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04disease0000000]{disease} and @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04poison00000000]{poison}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili16]{Immunity}: Fire elementals are immune to fire and heat-based attacks.

Elemental, Air.name: Elemental, Air
Elemental, Air.description:
Air elementals manifest as sentient whirlwinds.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili06]{Elemental}: No additional damage from @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0]{Called Shots}, ignores 1 point of Wound penalties, doesn’t breathe, immune to @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04disease0000000]{disease} and @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04poison00000000]{poison}.
  • Gaseous Form: Can maneuver through any non-solid surface, pass through cracks in doors or windows, bubble through water, etc.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili12]{Flight}: Air elementals fly at Pace 12″.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili19]{Invulnerability}: Immune to non-magical attacks.

Elemental, Water.name: Elemental, Water
Elemental, Water.description:
These spirits are frothing, man-shaped beings of water.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili00]{Aquatic}: Pace 12″.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili06]{Elemental}: No additional damage from @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0]{Called Shots}, ignores 1 point of Wound penalties, doesn’t breathe, immune to @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04disease0000000]{disease} and @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04poison00000000]{poison}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili16]{Immunity}: Immune to water-based attacks.
  • Seep: Can squeeze through any porous gap as if it were @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Difficult Ground}.

Shark, Bull.name: Shark, Bull
Shark, Bull.description:
These statistics cover bull sharks and white tips.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili00]{Aquatic}: @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Pace} 10.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 1: Sharks up to 500 pounds.

Soldier, Experienced.name: Soldier, Experienced
Soldier, Experienced.description: Goons, grunts, soldiers, or others with basic training serve as foot soldiers for more powerful characters. They should be customized and outﬁted to ﬁt their particular role.

Horse, War.name: Horse, War
Horse, War.description:
War horses are large beasts trained for aggression. They are trained to fight with both hooves, either to their front or their rear.

Special Abilities:

  • Size 3: Warhorses are large creatures bred for their power and stature.

Raptor (Birds of Prey).name: Raptor (Birds of Prey)
Raptor (Birds of Prey).description:
Eagles, hawks, and similar large birds of prey are collectively termed “raptors” (not to be confused with the dinosaur variety).

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili12]{Flight}: Raptors ﬂy at a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Pace} of 48″.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} −3 (Very Small): Raptors are light-weight and about two feet tall.

Minotaur.name: Minotaur
Minotaur.description:
Minotaurs stand over seven feet tall and have massive, bull-like heads and horns. In many fantasy worlds, they are used as guardians of labyrinths. In others, they are simply another race of creatures occupying a fantastically savage land. In all cases, they are fierce beasts eager for battle and the taste of their opponents’ flesh.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili24]{Resilient}: Minotaurs can take one Wound before they’re @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Incapacitated}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 3: Minotaurs stand over 7′ tall and have the mass of bulls.

Snake, Venomous.name: Snake, Venomous
Snake, Venomous.description:
Snakes in the real world are rarely aggressive unless cornered or frightened. They’re a staple of adventure ﬁction, however.

Here are the stats for Taipans (Australian brown snakes), cobras, and similar medium-sized snakes with extremely deadly poison.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili22]{Poison}: The GM chooses what kind of @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04poison00000000]{poison} the viper injects.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03sizeandscale00]{Size} −3 (Very Small): Most venomous snakes are 4–6′ in length, but only a few inches thick.

Drake.name: Drake
Drake.description:
Drakes are non-flying dragons with animal intelligence (rather than the more human-like sentience of true dragons). They are much more aggressive in direct combat than their distant cousins, however.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili10]{Fear}: Drakes are frightening creatures to behold.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili24]{Resilient}: Drakes can take one Wound before they’re Incapacitated.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 6 (Large): Drakes are over 20′ long from snout to tail.

Goblin.name: Goblin
Goblin.description:
Goblins of myth and legend are far more sin­is­ter creatures than some games and fiction portray. In the original tales, they were terrifying creatures that stole into homes in the middle of the night to steal and eat unruly children. The statistics here work for both dark “fairy tale” goblins as well as those found alongside orcs in contemporary roleplaying games.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili18]{Infravision} Halve penalties for Illumination when attacking warm targets.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} −1: Goblins stand 3–4′ tall.

Troll.name: Troll
Troll.description:
Trolls in myths and legends are horrid, ﬂesh-eating creatures who live in deep woods, beneath bridges, or in hidden mountain caves.

In modern games and ﬁction, trolls are monsters with the ability to regenerate damage other than that caused by ﬁre. These statistics reﬂect both backgrounds.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili23]{Fast Regeneration}: Trolls may attempt a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03healing0000000]{natural healing} roll every round, even if @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Incapacitated,} unless their @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Wounds} were caused by ﬁre or ﬂame or they’re put to the torch afterward.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili24]{Resilient}: Trolls can take one @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Wound} before they’re @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Incapacitated}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 1: Trolls are 8’ tall, lanky creatures.

Cat, Small.name: Cat, Small
Cat, Small.description:
This is an ordinary house cat, the sort that might be a familiar for a spellcaster, a @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-edges.Beast Master]{Beast Master}’s animal friend, or an alternate form for the @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-powers.Shape Change]{shape change} power.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili20]{Low Light Vision}: Cats ignore penalties for Dim and Dark @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03illumination00]{Illumination}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} −3 (Very Small): Cats are typically less than a foot high.

Skeleton.name: Skeleton
Skeleton.description:
The skin has already rotted from these risen dead, leaving them slightly quicker than their ﬂesh-laden zombie counterparts. They are often found swarming in vile necromancers’ legions.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili11]{Fearless}: Skeletons are immune to @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04fear0000000000]{Fear} and @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Intimidation]{Intimidation}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili29]{Undead}: +2 Toughness; +2 to recover from being @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken}; no additional damage from @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0]{Called Shots}; ignores 1 point of Wound penalties; doesn’t breathe; immune to @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04disease0000000]{disease} and @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04poison00000000]{poison}.

Werewolf.name: Werewolf
Werewolf.description:
When a full moon emerges, humans infected with lycan­thropy lose control and become snarling creatures bent on murder. Some embrace their cursed state and revel in the destruction they cause.

Customize the Special Abilities that make sense for your particular flesh-ripper. Older or “pure-blood” lycanthropes may be Invulnerable to all but silver or magic, for example.

Special Abilities:

  • Fast Regeneration: Werewolves may attempt a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03healing0000000]{natural healing} roll every round unless the Wounds were caused by silvered objects.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili10]{Fear} (−2): Were­wolves chill the blood of all who see them.
  • Infection: Anyone slain by a were­wolf has a 50% chance of rising as a werewolf themselves. The character involuntarily transforms every full moon. He gains control of his lycanthropy only after [[/sr 1d6 # Years after which the character gains control of lycanthropy]] years as a werewolf.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili18]{Infravision}: Halve penalties for @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03illumination00]{Illumination} when attacking warm targets.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 1: Werewolves are stout creatures.

Vampire, Ancient.name: Vampire, Ancient
Vampire, Ancient.description:
These statistics are for a vampire somewhat below the legendary Dracula, but far above those bloodsuckers fresh from the grave. The abilities listed here are standard—the GM may want to add other @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01edges000000000]{Edges} as befit the vampire’s previous lifestyle.

Special Abilities:

  • Change Form: As an action, a vampire can change into a wolf or bat with a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Smarts} roll at −2. Changing back into humanoid form requires a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Smarts} roll.
  • Charm: Vampires can use the @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-powers.Puppet]{puppet} power on those attracted to them (GM’s call) using their @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Smarts} as their @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor05powers.JournalEntryPage.05arcanebackgr00]{arcane skill}. They can cast and maintain the power indefinitely, but may only affect one target at a time.
  • Children of the Night: Ancient vampires have the ability to summon and control wolves or rats. This requires an action and a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Smarts} roll at −2. If successful, [[/sr 1d6 # Wolves summoned]] wolves or [[/sr 1d6 # Swarms of rats summoned]] swarms of rats (see @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-bestiary.Swarm]{Swarm}) come from the surrounding wilds in [[/sr 1d6+2 # Rounds until summoned]] rounds.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili19]{Invulnerability}: Vampires can only be slain by sunlight or a stake through the heart (see those Weaknesses, below). They may be @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken} by other attacks, but never @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Wounded}.
  • Mist: Ancient vampires have the ability to turn into mist. Doing so (or returning to human form) requires an action and a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Smarts} roll at −2.
  • Sire: Anyone slain by a vampire has a 50% chance of rising as a vampire in [[/r 1d4]] days.
  • Undead: +2 @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01characters0000]{Toughness}; +2 to recover from being @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken}; no additional damage from @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0]{Called Shots}; ignores 1 point of @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Wound} penalties; doesn’t breathe; immune to disease and poison.
  • Weakness (Holy Symbol): A character with a holy symbol may keep a vampire at bay by displaying a holy symbol. A vampire who wants to directly attack the victim must beat her in an opposed Spirit roll.
  • Weakness (Holy Water): A vampire sprinkled with holy water is Fatigued. If immersed, he combusts as if it were direct sunlight (see below).
  • Weakness (Invitation Only): Vampires cannot enter a private dwelling without being invited. They may enter public domains as they please.
  • Weakness (Stake Through the Heart): A vampire hit with a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03calledshots000]{Called Shots} to the heart (−4) must make a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Vigor} roll versus the damage. If successful, it takes damage normally. If it fails, it disintegrates to dust.
  • Weakness (Sunlight): Vampires burn in sunlight. They take [[/r 2d4]] damage per round until they are ash. Armor protects normally.

Dog / Wolf.name: Dog / Wolf
Dog / Wolf.description:
The stats below are for large attack dogs, such as Rottweilers and Doberman Pinschers, as well as wolves, hyenas, and the like.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} −1: The heads of these canines come to an average human’s waist, and they weigh about 60 pounds.
  • Speed: d10 @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{running die}.

Spider, Giant.name: Spider, Giant
Spider, Giant.description:
Giant spiders are about the size of large dogs and live in nests of 1d6+2 arachnids. They frequently go hunting in packs when prey is scarce in their home lair.

Their dens are litered with the bones and treasures of their victims, often providing ripe pickings for those brave enough to venture within.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili22]{Poison} (−4): Usually @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04poison00000000]{Mild} or @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04poison00000000]{Lethal}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} −1:These spiders are dog-sized.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili30]{Wall Walker}:The creatures move at their full @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Pace} on walls and ceilings! Creepy!

Orc, Chieftain.name: Orc, Chieftain
Orc, Chieftain.description:
The leader of a small orc clan is always the most deadly brute in the bunch. Orc chieftains generally have a magical item or two in settings where such things are relatively common (most “swords & sorcery” worlds).

Note:

Orc chieftains have a 7 @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01characters0000]{Parry} when wielding a Great Axe.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili18]{Infravision}: Halve penalties for @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03illumination00]{Illumination} when attacking warm targets.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 1: Orcs are slightly larger than humans.

Soldier.name: Soldier
Soldier.description: Goons, grunts, soldiers, or others with basic training serve as foot soldiers for more powerful characters. They should be customized and outﬁted to ﬁt their particular role.

Summon Ally: Sentinel.name: Summon Ally: Sentinel
Summon Ally: Sentinel.description:
Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili05]{Construct}: +2 to recover from being @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken}; ignore 1 point of Wound penalties; doesn't breathe, immune @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04disease0000000]{disease} or @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04poison00000000]{poison}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili11]{Fearless}: Immune to @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04fear0000000000]{fear} and @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Intimidation]{Intimidation}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 2: Sentinels are 8' tall and very dense.

Bull.name: Bull
Bull.description:
Bulls are usually only aggressive toward humans when enraged. Of course, if you’re looking up the statistics here, it’s probably already seeing red.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 3: Most bulls weigh just under a ton.

Alligator/Crocodile.name: Alligator/Crocodile
Alligator/Crocodile.description:
Alligators and crocodiles are staples of most pulp-genre adventure games. The statistics here represent an average specimen of either species. Much larger versions are often found in more remote areas.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili00]{Aquatic}: @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Pace} 5.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 1: Common gators are about 6 to 7′ long, thick, heavy, and weigh just under 500 lbs.

Shark, Great White.name: Shark, Great White
Shark, Great White.description:
These statistics cover great whites, 18 to 25 feet long.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili00]{Aquatic}: @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Pace}.10
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili14]{Hardy}: The creature does not suﬀer a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Wound} from being @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken} twice.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 4 (Large): Great whites can grow up to 25′ in length.

Vampire.name: Vampire
Vampire.description:
Blood-drinkers of lore are common in many fantasy games. This is a relatively young vampire minion. For weaker vampires, ignore the @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili19]{Invulnerability} Special Ability.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili19]{Invulnerability}: Vampires can only be slain by sunlight or a stake through the heart (see those Weaknesses, below). They may be @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken} by other attacks, but never @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Wounded}.
  • Sire: Anyone slain by a vampire has a 50% chance of rising as a vampire in [[/r 1d4]] days.
  • Undead: +2 @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01characters0000]{Toughness}; +2 to recover from being @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken}; no additional damage from @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0]{Called Shots}; ignores 1 point of @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Wound} penalties; doesn’t breathe; immune to disease and poison.
  • Weakness (Holy Symbol): A character with a holy symbol may keep a vampire at bay by displaying a holy symbol. A vampire who wants to directly attack the victim must beat her in an opposed Spirit roll.
  • Weakness (Holy Water): A vampire sprinkled with holy water is Fatigued. If immersed, he combusts as if it were direct sunlight (see below).
  • Weakness (Invitation Only): Vampires cannot enter a private dwelling without being invited. They may enter public domains as they please.
  • Weakness (Stake Through the Heart): A vampire hit with a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03calledshots000]{Called Shots} to the heart (−4) must make a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Vigor} roll versus the damage. If successful, it takes damage normally. If it fails, it disintegrates to dust.
  • Weakness (Sunlight): Vampires burn in sunlight. They take [[/r 2d4]] damage per round until they are ash. Armor protects normally.

Bear.name: Bear
Bear.description:
This entry covers the larger ursines, such as grizzlies, Kodiaks, and polar bears. A favored tactic of all these bears is to grapple and bite with their fierce fangs.

Special Abilities:
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 2: These creatures can stand up to 8′ tall and weigh over 1,000 pounds.

Snake, Constrictor.name: Snake, Constrictor
Snake, Constrictor.description:
Snakes in the real world are rarely aggressive unless cornered or frightened. They’re a staple of adventure ﬁction, however.

Pythons, boa constrictors, and other snakes over 15′ long are rarely deadly to man in the real world because they aren’t particularly aggressive. In games, however, such snakes might be provoked, drugged, or just plain mean.

Special Abilities:

  • Constrict: +2 to @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Athletics} and @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Strength} rolls made to @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03grappling00000]{grapple}.

Shark.name: Shark
Shark.description:
These statistics cover bull sharks and white tips.

Special Abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili00]{Aquatic}: @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Pace} 10.
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor06bestia.JournalEntryPage.06specialabili25]{Size} 1: Sharks up to 500 pounds.
